description.narrative: PROJECT AIMING TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF LIFE AND HYGIENIC STANDARDS OF THE POPULATION; TO CONTROL ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARD AND TO ENHACNE THE EFFICIENCY OF SEWERAGE INFRASTRUCTURE BY ENSURING PROPER MAINTENANCE. PROGRAMME INCLUDE 145 KM OF SEWERAGE NETWORKS, 10 PUMPING STATIONS, 12541 CONNECTIONS, 3 WASTE WATER TREATMENT STATIONS AND ACQUISITION OF NETWORK MAINTENANCE EQUIPMENT.
